title: Backend Engineer
description: We're looking for a backend engineer comfortable with Python, FastAPI, and SQL databases. You'll build REST APIs, work with Docker for deployment, and collaborate with a small team using Git.

title: Machine Learning Intern
description: Assist the ML team with data preprocessing using Pandas and NumPy, train models with scikit-learn and PyTorch, and help evaluate NLP pipelines.

title: Frontend Developer
description: Build responsive interfaces with React, TypeScript, and modern CSS. Experience with REST API integration and Git-based workflows required.

title: QA / Automation Engineer
description: Own our test automation using Selenium and Playwright. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Python scripting is a big plus.

title: Data Engineer
description: Design data pipelines using Python and SQL, manage infrastructure on AWS, and maintain PostgreSQL and MongoDB data stores.
